name: Sona BLW Precision Forgings Ltd
title: Sona BLW Precision Forgings Ltd - 543300 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 FY26 record revenue of ₹1,272 cr (+47% YoY) and EBITDA margin 24.4%, but commodity and mix pressure persists; management says EBITDA band is 23–25% post railway deal, with ~₹1,270 cr cash and order book ₹237 bn.

triggers.label: Commodity inflation squeezing margins
triggers.quote: there is always a lag and that lag along with the arithmetic impact on both revenue and cost, will put pressure on our margins

triggers.label: Q4 EV orders: 3 from European OEMs
triggers.quote: we've won 3 driveline orders from European OEMs in a single quarter. This is the highest we've ever done

triggers.label: EBITDA band 23–25% post railway
triggers.quote: I think now it is 23 to 25%, and that, I think we can say we should be able to continue being in that band.

guidance.quote: I think now it is 23 to 25%, and that, I think we can say we should be able to continue being in that band.

red_flags.label: Commodity-driven margin squeeze
red_flags.quote: until we have commodity price inflation, you will see this impact one way or the other

red_flags.label: Gas supply constraint
red_flags.quote: gas availability has been a challenge, as all of you would know

evasions.quote: As you know, we don't use the phrase kit value because to be honest, I don't understand it.
That is a multi-trillion dollar question, in some sense
